briefs.text: Lula meets Chief Raoni on Indigenous land.
Ruling party moves to impeach Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae.
Rio Tinto pledges $370m for Panguna mine legacy.
CBO warns AUKUS sub costs shrink US fleet.
St Johns River hits record 18.3 ft; four counties shut schools.
US Army sets noon detonation of 68 unstable explosive barrels.
Pacific kingdom declares emergency as El Niño drought bites.
Pentagon puts US war cost vs Iran at $4.38bn.
UK & Norway fund £100m+ for two Ukrainian naval vessels.
Denmark's parliament approves Greenland defence bill.
Indonesia's parliament passes asset-forfeiture bill.
UN marks World Children's Day across member states.
Zoo's famed hippo Fiona dies days after swallowing hat.
President Faye enacts supplementary budget by decree.
Four attacks on vessels in 96 hours, maritime centre says.
Pakistan minister to lead delegation to SCO dialogue.
U17 World Cup: Australia stun Argentina 2–0.
Harmer spins Proteas to Test win; Bavuma sets record.
Badminton Open rematch semifinals after upset.
Short-sell curbs take effect; two Russian bombers tracked.
Alcaraz–Cobolli & Medvedev–Tiafoe close ATP Finals groups.
Thomas Markle ruled to stand trial.
Henry Nicholls scores 175* in 216-run stand with Phillips.
China holds lending rates for 18th month (1-yr 3.0%, 5-yr 3.5%).
